name: Qal’at al-Bahrain – Ancient Harbour and Capital of Dilmun
description: On Bahrain's northern coast, Qal'at al-Bahrain is a 12-metre mound built up from some 4,000 years of people living, trading and rebuilding on the same spot. It was once the capital of the Dilmun civilization, previously known only from Sumerian texts. Archaeologists have uncovered homes, shops, temples and defences, and a Portuguese fort still crowns the summit.
